descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · UAT 3.6; UAT OAT-04 ER 2 · “Course timeline and prior transcripts therefore show today and yesterday only.”.

Bug B19 · excluded (All tickets still in progress / ready for PR (not counted, Quinn 2026-10-14)) · was S1

Retention / purge is not implemented per UAT 3.6: 13-hour Important Points and 37-hour tasks, handoffs and vitals are still there; nothing is purged unless a device opens the app; past 500 patients some charts are skipped

Tickets: TFA-94699 in progress · counts as a QA bug: no (ticket in progress) · found on: local

Note: One root cause behind 19 cases; the windows themselves are decision D6 Re-test 2026-10-20 on 8b4be94a: changed: Important Points now expire per card at 12 h on the server (TFA-92590, TC-12/S05 passes); the window is a code constant (TC-12/S29); 19 h previous note, 37 h open tasks and every other server purge still fail (TC-13/S12, S15, TC-07/S11, TC-17/S23).

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): OAT-04/S01, OAT-04/S04, OAT-04/S07, OAT-04/S08, OAT-04/S11, OAT-04/S14, OAT-04/S15, OAT-04/S17, OAT-04/S23, OAT-04/S24, OAT-04/S27, TC-10/S21, TC-11/S25, TC-12/S05, TC-13/S15, TC-13/S16, TC-12/S29, TC-13/S29, TC-07/S11, TC-13/S12

Approach · OAT-04 Data Retention · S26 Course timeline keeps today and yesterday only: lines dated D-3, D-2, D-1 and D0

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U16 The Hospital course timeline keeps only today's and yesterday's lines (server days); older lines are deleted from the chart, not only hidden. (UAT 3.6 (course timeline and prior transcripts show today and yesterday only); UAT 3.7 (retention claim); TFA-94699 snapshot (TFA-92589 / PR #91 hands the purge of older lines to this ticket)) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U11 Live patient data never survives past its window: once an item clears, no copy of it remains anywhere live (other fields of the chart, dated histories, the patient-list row, handoffs, drafts). … (UAT OAT-04 Expected 2; UAT 3.7 (retention claim)) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress

Test design technique: Boundary values (boundary) — Sit right on the edge of the rule (exactly on time / a minute late, empty, longest, most) and see on which side the behavior changes.

Given Hospital patient whose admissionSummary.course holds four lines dated (server days) D-3 'RET-COURSE-912', D-2 'RET-COURSE-913', D-1 'RET-COURSE-914' and D0 'RET-COURSE-915'

When The purge runs (the server job; on main nothing touches admissionSummary.course); the raw document is read with admin access

Then Only the D-1 and D0 lines remain in the raw document; the D-3 and D-2 lines are gone, not only hidden from the timeline

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT 3.6 ('Course timeline and prior transcripts therefore show today and yesterday only'), the TFA-92589 -> TFA-94699 purge handoff and the 3.7 retention claim: the D-3 line present in any form = Fail (older than 36 h under any reading); the D-2 line in the raw document = Fail per U16 even if not shown; the D-1 or D0 line missing = Fail (too early). Days are server days (3.8)

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method API · API (Convex functions); lane planned in the matrix: manual (blocked)

S26 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-04.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: Known product issue · environment local · tickets TFA-92589 ready for qa; TFA-94699 in progress

37 h after the course was last refreshed, the stored course still holds the lines from 3 and 2 days ago; the screen hides them, but the purge never deletes them.

Evidence: allure 3a385cb9-…-result.json; retention lane. 2 checks pass, 2 fail (D-3, D-2), known K6 (the TFA-92589 → TFA-94699 purge handoff). Which clock clears an old line (S26 vs TC-11/S25) is recorded only.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 8b4be94a (10-20), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: API · API (Convex functions); secondary: CODEREVIEW · Code review — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: newspec-c.
